answer: Audit agents at random, like a comet flashing through a dark sky: each epoch a lottery picks a few identities and demands proof of their claimed past work, checked against the ledger. A karst landscape hides water in cracks, but an audit finds the gaps fast — fakes have no real work to show, so their stake is slashed and the identity is burned. Honest agents pass easily since their history is genuine, while a farm faces a gale of audits where every fake carries a chance of total loss, turning scale into a liability.
